V3 动画涡轮增压

干净实用的 ComfyUI 工作流程，专为CyberRealistic Anima / 动画风格生成.

此工作流程旨在作为创建高质量动画、半写实和风格化图像的简单起点，并具有用于首次生成、可选放大和可选面部细节的平衡设置。

工作流程文件
此上传内容包括JSON 工作流程和一个PNG工作流程图像.
如果您希望加载工作流并保留原始节点布局、组位置和视觉格式，请使用 PNG 版本。

提示格式节点

此工作流程使用我的自定义 Cyberdelia 提示格式节点：

https://github.com/cyberdeliaAI/comfyui-cyberdelia-prompt-format

如果您希望工作流以预期的 Cyberdelia 格式加载和保存提示元数据，请安装此自定义节点。

V3 Anima Turbo

A clean and practical ComfyUI workflow built forCyberRealistic Anima / Anima-style generation.

This workflow is designed as an easy starting point for creating high-quality anime, semi-realistic, and stylized images with a balanced setup for first-pass generation, optional upscaling, and optional face detailing.

Workflow files
This upload includes both theJSON workflowand aPNG workflow image.
Use the PNG version if you want the workflow to load with the original node layout, group positions, and visual formatting preserved.

Prompt Format Node

This workflow uses my custom Cyberdelia prompt format node:

https://github.com/cyberdeliaAI/comfyui-cyberdelia-prompt-format

Install this custom node if you want the workflow to load and save prompt metadata in the intended Cyberdelia format.

Updates

The latest updates, fixes, and newer versions of this workflow will be posted here:

https://whop.com/cyberdelia-ai-lab/comfy-ui-workflows-anima-7PyhuAgLz9eJ5R/app/
